rooms.name: Wastelands
rooms.description: The wastelands spread out from here offering little solstice as the grit blows about the area in all direction. A large pile of garbage prevents further travel west. A path west leads into East Southfield.

scenery.name: wasteland
description: A place of violent death and great destruction.
